job: Define a versioned, provider-neutral DesignIntent contract that carries cabin program and provenance as bounded typed facts, assumptions, confidence, and unresolved fields while refusing unknown keys and all model-authored geometry.
reject: the root or any nested object accepts, strips, or ignores an unknown key
coordinates, vertices, edges, walls, polygons, transforms, or other free-form geometry can enter DesignIntent
requested use, approximate footprint, storeys, rooms, roof, openings, materials, climate, or siting has no bounded typed representation
assumptions, unresolved fields, confidence, or source provenance is absent, implicit, unbounded, duplicated, or silently invented
invalid enum values, non-finite numbers, unsafe integers, empty identifiers, or out-of-range quantities pass validation
parsing mutates input, returns an input alias, or produces non-deterministic output
the contract calls a network, model, provider, wallet, payment, persistence, project-mutation, or geometry service
a website 3D, rendering, animation, engine, scene, public visual, model, texture, shader, camera, lighting, motion, or quality-tier path changes
verification: fixture: every accepted field survives a parse-and-clone round trip
fixture: unknown keys fail at the root and every nested object rather than being stripped
fixture: geometry-shaped root and nested keys are named and refused
fixture: malformed, non-finite, unsafe, duplicate, empty, excessive, and out-of-range values fail closed
fixture: parser output is detached, frozen, deterministic, and contains no input alias

evidence.writeOwnership: No active manifest owns an overlapping path; UX03 is blocked and all other instantiated nodes are verified.
evidence.existingSurfaceAudit: No DesignIntent type or runtime schema exists; existing project, building-graph, discovery, confidence, and assumption contracts remain downstream consumers rather than a parallel geometry input.
